newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SSL to raise S$400 mln for properties.
newsitem.headline: SSL to raise S$400 mln for properties.

text.p: Straits Steamship Land Ltd (SSL) said on Monday it was raising Singapore $400 million to finance two property projects in Singapore.
It will issue S$200 million Unsecured Floating Rate Notes (FRNs) due in 2002 and S$200 million unsecured bonds due in 2001.
The bonds will have a coupon rate of 4 and 15/16 percent and will be issued in a single tranche. The FRNs will be issued in several tranches with interst pegged at market rates.
SSL has appointed Keppel Bank of Singapore to arrange and manage the issues.
